authority: Retained-data presentation only; no scoring or selection rule change
generation_addressing: Admitted dense generations0..800: array indices are explicit positions in the named source array; verify range/count/hash joins before constructing each pointer.
public_identity: public_run_id and source-bound package, not legacy reader_label/run_number
positive_scale: Full compatible original run range; constant/singleton1original-unit fallback; overflow-factorized when necessary.
gap_reference: One fixed final retained best of this own compatible run; never a running-best reference.
generation_display: log10(g+1) for positive views, linear for asinh; generation0 retained
leader: Use current raw-stream retained leader ties/order; representative index0 preserves that admitted source order.
token_authority: Exact numeric serialization of generated retained-leaders JSON, not asserted to be original CSV spelling.
median_authority: Preserved admitted full-population gen_median_fit summary; no legal-only substitution. Not independently recomputed by story renderer.
unknown_values: Remain typed missing, never assigned epsilon or zero.
placement: Full text width only; actual rendered print review required
view_selection: Bounded comparison; no superiority or selected main variant claimed before actual print-size readback.
